cli.refresh_help.refresh.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.refresh.note: Top-level summary: request a move to the installed build at the next safe boundary, without signals or termination.

cli.refresh_help.target.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.target.note: Positional selector accepts conversation name, session id, pid, or cwd substring and ignores case.

cli.refresh_help.pid.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.pid.note: --pid chooses an exact process identifier; preserve the flag token.

cli.refresh_help.session.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.session.note: --session chooses the exact session identifier, not a fuzzy selector.

cli.refresh_help.all.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.all.note: --all asks every live session on this machine; no confirmation is needed because refresh ends nothing.

cli.refresh_help.json.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.json.note: --json emits one machine-readable outcome per target, not an aggregate status.

cli.refresh_help.timeout.tone: terse, operator-facing, describes a flag or command
cli.refresh_help.timeout.note: --timeout bounds the wait for each session answer separately, with a default of 10 seconds.
